articles.title: PM Modi positions Brics as an inclusive, not anti-west, forum
articles.description: Prime Minister Modi opened the Brics summit, demanding urgent United Nations Security Council reforms. He stressed transforming global governance from privilege to partnership for developing nations. Modi proposed Brics draft ten proposals for inclusive global governance and multilateralism. He also called for a Seafarers Emergency Support Network for maritime workers. The summit aims to empower the Global South as rule-shapers, not rule-takers.

articles.title: Two giant dams starved the Danube Delta of sediment for decades
articles.description: The Danube's sediment supply to its delta has significantly decreased due to upstream engineering works. Large dams like the Iron Gates trap sediment, altering the natural balance of the delta. This reduction in material has led to increased coastal erosion along the delta's seaward edge. Recently, ten obsolete dams were removed from smaller rivers to reconnect fragmented habitats.

articles.title: India’s gem exports rise 3.14% in August as studded gold jewellery shipments surge
articles.description: India's gem and jewellery exports saw a 3.14% increase in August, reaching $2.30 billion. This growth was primarily fueled by a significant rise in studded gold jewellery shipments. Diamond export volumes also contributed positively to the overall export performance during the month. Plain gold jewellery exports experienced a decline due to rising gold prices and input costs. The industry is evolving into a global hub for design and value addition.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Celine Dion starts her 26-day Paris residency on Saturday
articles.description: Celine Dion has made a triumphant return to live performance following a two-year break, launching her residency in Paris. Her emotional opening night saw her wiping away tears as she thanked fans for their steadfast support and understanding. This concert symbolizes her first full show since the cancellation of her 2020 tour. Dion's residency is scheduled to continue with more performances until March 2027.
